[ASSISTANT_SAID] Reducing plastic use in the kitchen is a fantastic step towards a more sustainable lifestyle.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for alternatives to plastic utensils include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Bamboo utensils: Durable, lightweight, and easy to clean.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Stainless steel or metal utensils: Durable, easy to clean, and recyclable.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Wooden utensils: Sustainably sourced wood, great alternative to plastic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Silicone utensils: Heat-resistant, flexible, and easy to clean.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for storage containers include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Glass containers: Durable and a great alternative to plastic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Stainless steel containers: Non-toxic and easy to clean.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Bamboo or wooden containers: Sustainable alternatives to plastic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Beeswax wraps: Reusable, biodegradable, and compostable alternative to plastic wrap.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Avoid single-use utensils.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Choose products with minimal packaging.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Upcycle or repurpose old containers or utensils.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Support eco-friendly brands.
